declarations.docstring: The indexed twisted shifts are linearly independent, and their span is the underlying module of the generated subalgebra.
An auxiliary type associated with a commutative ring.
The endomorphism indexed by an integer pair, with twisting parameter a unit of the coefficient ring.
The family of twisted shift endomorphisms indexed by pairs of integers is linearly independent.
Every indexed twisted shift belongs to the subalgebra generated by the family.
The product of two twisted shifts is a scalar multiple of the shift indexed by the sum of their integer pairs.
The shifts in the two coordinate directions commute up to multiplication by the twisting unit.
Applying a twisted shift to a singleton translates its integer-pair index and scales its coefficient by the prescribed power of the twisting unit.
The twisted shift indexed by the zero integer pair is the identity endomorphism.
The subalgebra of endomorphisms generated by the integer-pair-indexed twisted shifts.
The underlying submodule of the generated subalgebra is the span of the twisted shift family.
